title: Naturality of the Cech-to-cohomology isomorphism for affine covers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal U:X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ an open covering with all $U_{i_0\dots i_p}$ affine, and let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ be a morphism of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then for every $p\geq0$ the isomorphisms $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)\cong H^p(X,\mathcal F)$ and $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F')\cong H^p(X,\mathcal F')$ of [lem-pc-cech-computes] carry the map on Cech cohomology induced by the cochain map $(c_{i_0\dots i_p})\mapsto(\varphi(c_{i_0\dots i_p}))$ to the map $H^p(X,\varphi)$ of [pqf-def-cohomology].

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma Tag 01EQ (cohomology-lemma-cech-cohomology, line 1434): the canonical maps $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)\to H^p(U,\mathcal F)$ come from a transformation of functors on $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$; with Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma Tag 01XD (coherent-lemma-cech-cohomology-quasi-coherent, line 246)
